text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a lightweight drip for the onboarding waitlist after launch. goal = nudge -> convert -> webinar invite over 3 emails. low friction, short copy.

sam: love it. can we split by intent signal? 1) high intent (clicked pricing), 2) low intent (newsletter only), 3) enterprise leads (company email).

tyler: yes. segments we already have: `clicked_pricing`, `newsletter_only`, `company_email`. will export CSV today.

maria: perfect. rough cadence idea: E1: welcome + quick value props (day 0), E2: short case study + CTA to try (day 3), E3: webinar invite / demo (day 10).

olivia: subject line ideas? for E1 i like: "Welcome — your Redwood waitlist spot + what to expect" or A/B with "You're on the list — next steps". testing opens only on the high-intent segment first.

anna: suggestion for E2 CTA copy: "See latency & cost in action" vs "See a 3-min demo". which is better for dev audiences?

sam: for devs, "3-min demo" usually wins. keep technical detail in the body (throughput numbers, example curl).

maria: good — include a tiny snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
``` put that in E2 for high-intent.

tyler: send windows: target PST mornings for high-intent (Tue/Th 9am), low-intent go midweek afternoons. is that aligned with past sends?

olivia: yes, history shows better opens in mornings for technical segments. low-intent performs okay Wed 2pm.

anna: tracking: open, click, webinar signup, dev signups. set a UTM param: `utm_campaign=waitlist_drip_q3` and `utm_content={segment}`.

marketing-bot: reminder set: campaign draft due in `#marketing` by Tue EOD. :spiral_calendar_pad:

sam: who's owner for segment mapping + suppressions? tyler for mapping, maria for copy, olivia for subject tests, anna for tracking. I'll own rollout in Braze.

maria: assigned. can we keep E1 body <120 words and include single CTA button (learn more)?

tyler: noted. I'll drop sample CSV to `#marketing` with columns: `email,segment,intent_score,company,signup_ts`.

olivia: small ask — add a pro-rate path: if `intent_score > 80` show enterprise CTA linking to demo calendar.

anna: i'll wire up event tracking for demo calendar clicks + trial starts. please give me the calendar link and final CTAs.

maria: calendar link will be `https://cal.redwood.ai/demo` — use `utm_medium=email` on the link.

sam: rollout plan: stage 1 (high-intent only, send to 5k) next Tue -> monitor opens/clicks 24h -> expand to remaining segments on Thu. if open rate < 12% pause and iterate subject.

tyler: CSV export ETA: tomorrow 10am.

olivia: creative ask: include a small GIF of the console in E1? keeps it visual without heavy assets. i'll make a 2s loop.

maria: yes keep it tiny. optimize for <100KB.

anna: note for analytics: create cohort `waitlist_drip_q3_high` for conversion funnel.

sam: cool — next checkpoint here Monday after copy draft. thanks all. :thumbsup:
